column1: # apt packages, by group. One group may span several lines.
# Versions are deliberately NOT pinned. Ubuntu's archive removes superseded
# versions, so `apt-get install ripgrep=14.1.1-1` starts failing the moment
# resolute-updates rotates the package -- a pin here would reduce reproducibility
# rather than add it. What we fix is the *set* of packages; security updates and
# point releases are welcome. Anything version-sensitive lives in tools.tsv.
